pipeline_name: Phase 1 Leakage-Free Crop Phenological Feature Extraction

baseline_strategy.formula: Mean of preceding eligible yields in [crop_year - 3, crop_year - 1]
baseline_strategy.zero_leakage_guarantee: Current crop_year and all future crop_years are strictly excluded.
baseline_strategy.eligibility_threshold: Requires at least 2 preceding years in [t-3, t-1] (is_eligible_for_anomaly_training == 1).

status_types.VALID_3YR_ROLLING: Full 3 preceding years available in [t-3, t-1]. Eligible for training.
status_types.VALID_2YR_ROLLING: 2 preceding years available in [t-3, t-1]. Eligible for training.
status_types.WARMUP_1YR_LAG: 1 preceding year available. Target yield_anomaly_pct set to NaN. Excluded from anomaly training.
status_types.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: 0 preceding years available (e.g. 2001). Target yield_anomaly_pct set to NaN. Excluded from anomaly training.

soil_moisture_specification.source: ECMWF ERA5-Land monthly reanalysis via Copernicus Climate Data Store
soil_moisture_specification.topsoil_layer1: Depth: 0 to 7 cm skin topsoil moisture (m3/m3). Reflects rapid surface drying.
soil_moisture_specification.root_zone_approx: Thickness-weighted average of Layer 2 (7-28 cm, 21 cm) and Layer 3 (28-100 cm, 72 cm): (21*L2 + 72*L3) / 93.
soil_moisture_specification.scientific_limitation: The root zone feature is an approximation from reanalysis modeling across 7-100 cm, not an in-situ probe measurement.

Maize.growth_stage_at_mid_season: Flowering / Tasseling & Silking (~Day 50-60). Pre-harvest (grain harvest Jan W3 / Jul W2).
Maize.sowing_calendar_evidence: DOA/AFACI (2013) Maize: Sowing Oct W2-Nov W2 / Apr W1-Apr W4; total life cycle 110-120 days.

Chilli.growth_stage_at_mid_season: Flowering / Early fruit development. Pre-harvest for major picking.
Chilli.sowing_calendar_evidence: DOA/AFACI (2013) Chilli: Transplanting Oct W3-Nov W3 / Apr W2-May W2; total life cycle 150-180 days.

Green Gram.growth_stage_at_mid_season: Flowering / Pod setting (~Day 30-35). Pre-harvest lead time: capped 3-4 weeks prior to first harvest.
Green Gram.sowing_calendar_evidence: DOA/AFACI (2013) Green Gram: Sowing Oct W3-Nov W3 / Apr W2-May W2; harvesting Dec W4-Jan W4 / Jun W2-Jul W3; total life cycle 65-75 days.
Green Gram.sowing_variability_caveat: Exact flowering timing varies by 1-2 weeks depending on rainfall onset and farmer planting decisions.

real_time_usable_at_cutoff: All pre-season and mid-season daily weather aggregations (rainfall, temp, heat days, dry spells)
Mid-season SPI and Soil Moisture (uses prior closed month: Nov for Dec 15; Oct for Nov 15; May for Jun 15; Apr for May 15, published 8-12 days before cutoff)
operational_latency_caution_at_cutoff: Pre-season SPI-1/SPI-3 (uses Sep for Oct 01 / Mar for Apr 01; requires 1-3 days post month-end for Met Dept calculation)
Pre-season ERA5-Land monthly soil moisture (official CDS release has 5-7 days latency; real-time operational deployment on Oct 01 / Apr 01 requires preliminary ERA5T data or station probe proxies)

macro_shock_control.rationale: Statistical control for nationwide chemical fertilizer import ban (April 2021). Not a causal proof or fertilizer advisory tool.
